flaming.name: Flaming
flaming.description: Upon command, a flaming weapon sheathes its blade in fire, dealing an extra 1d6 points of fire damage on a successful hit.

flaming_burst.name: Flaming Burst
flaming_burst.description: A flaming burst weapon deals +1d6 fire damage on hit and explodes with flame upon scoring a critical hit (+1d10 on x2, +2d10 on x3, +3d10 on x4).

frost.name: Frost
frost.description: Upon command, a frost weapon is sheathed in a cold, icy aura, dealing an extra 1d6 points of cold damage on a successful hit.

icy_burst.name: Icy Burst
icy_burst.description: An icy burst weapon deals +1d6 cold damage on hit and erupts with frost on a critical hit (+1d10 on x2, +2d10 on x3, +3d10 on x4).

shock.name: Shock
shock.description: Upon command, a shock weapon is sheathed in crackling electricity, dealing an extra 1d6 points of electricity damage on a successful hit.

shocking_burst.name: Shocking Burst
shocking_burst.description: A shocking burst weapon deals +1d6 electricity damage on hit and creates an electrical burst on a critical hit (+1d10 on x2, +2d10 on x3, +3d10 on x4).

keen.name: Keen
keen.description: This ability doubles the normal threat range of a weapon.

ghost_touch.name: Ghost Touch
ghost_touch.description: A ghost touch weapon deals normal damage against incorporeal creatures regardless of the bonus. Incorporeal armor bonuses also apply against incorporeal touch attacks.

effectBundle.name: Ghost Touch
effectBundle.description: Full damage and protection against incorporeal foes.

holy.name: Holy
holy.description: A holy weapon is imbued with holy power, dealing +2d6 damage against evil creatures and bypassing damage reduction as a good-aligned weapon.

unholy.name: Unholy
unholy.description: An unholy weapon is imbued with unholy power, dealing +2d6 damage against good creatures and bypassing damage reduction as an evil-aligned weapon.

bane.name: Bane
bane.description: A bane weapon excels at attacking one type or subtype of creature. Against its designated foe, its effective enhancement bonus is +2 higher than normal and it deals an extra 2d6 points of damage.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: When making a full attack, a weapon of speed grants one extra attack at full base attack bonus.

effectBundle.name: Speed
effectBundle.description: One extra attack at highest BAB during full attack.

animated.name: Animated
animated.description: An animated shield floats in the air to protect its wielder, freeing both hands.

fortification_light.name: Light Fortification
fortification_light.description: This suit of armor or shield produces a magical force that protects vital areas (25% chance to ignore critical hits or sneak attacks).

effectBundle.name: Light Fortification
effectBundle.description: 25% chance to ignore critical hits and sneak attacks.

fortification_moderate.name: Moderate Fortification
fortification_moderate.description: 75% chance to ignore critical hits or sneak attacks.

effectBundle.name: Moderate Fortification
effectBundle.description: 75% chance to ignore critical hits and sneak attacks.

fortification_heavy.name: Heavy Fortification
fortification_heavy.description: 100% chance to ignore critical hits or sneak attacks.

effectBundle.name: Heavy Fortification
effectBundle.description: 100% chance to ignore critical hits and sneak attacks.
